meta.title: Osppy · Business and technology consulting
meta.description: Osppy is a business and technology consultancy, AI-native and deeply human. We help you reimagine your company from a digital perspective.

quienes.frase: Osppy is a business and technology consultancy, AI-native and deeply human. We help you reimagine your company from a digital perspective.
quienes.origen: We came to consulting from building and operating systems that work in real businesses today. That is why we start with the business, not the tool.

proposito.texto: That the companies we work with prosper and compete at the highest level. We believe technology is worth it when the people who run and operate a business understand it, use it and make it their own.

creemos.texto: That people and the business come first, and technology second. That artificial intelligence is not a separate project, but a way of working. That the best solutions are built with the client's team and stay with it.

etapas.texto: We understand your operation in depth: how your people work, where the information lives and what really hurts.
We turn what we find into a strategic plan: what comes first, what follows and what is not worth it yet, with scope and success criteria in writing.
We build hand in hand with you and leave it running. If your people can do it, we train them to do it.
We stay until your team walks on its own, and then we stay close: operation, maintenance and whatever comes next.

estrategia.texto: Deciding what technology your business needs, in what order and for what, before buying anything.

datos.texto: Bringing together the information that is scattered today, organizing it and making sure your people can read it.

ia.texto: Putting artificial intelligence to work inside your operation (answering, classifying, drafting, reviewing), with a person who decides.

nube.texto: Moving and modernizing your systems, and operating them in an orderly way.

sistemas.texto: Implementing and connecting the applications your team and your customers work with.

experiencia.texto: Designing how your customers and your people live each process, from first contact to service.

producto.texto: Building the product or platform your business needs, from the inside, not just configuring it.

entrega.texto: Taking the project from start to finish: scope, priorities, dates and deliveries.

items: Artificial intelligence agents: systems that complete a whole task on their own, with the business's information and the rules someone wrote
Models deployed in the client's own infrastructure, with Amazon Bedrock

items.texto: organizations report productivity and efficiency gains from artificial intelligence.
items.fuente: Deloitte, State of AI in the Enterprise, 2026

items.texto: of companies capture substantial value from artificial intelligence, and they achieve five times the revenue increases of the laggards in the areas where they apply it.
items.fuente: BCG, The Widening AI Value Gap, 2025

items.texto: of large companies remain in isolated pilots; only 13.8% have taken artificial intelligence into the core of their business.

real.encabezado: Osppy's systems operate today in real businesses.
real.giros: Systems operating in manufacturing, automotive, logistics, construction, foreign trade and retail.

hablemos.encabezado: What comes next for your company, we build it with you.
hablemos.texto: Tell us how your company operates and we will tell you where we can help and where we cannot.

lineas: Training is quoted per group and per result, never per hour.
Advisory and implementations are quoted separately, each with scope and success criteria in writing.
After delivery, there are operation plans: hosting, monitoring and maintenance.
precio.cierre: The figures, in the first conversation.

productos.texto: Osppy also develops its own products for the industries it operates in.
